context: Late check-out until 2 PM is available for $30.
Smoking is strictly prohibited in all rooms.

cases.name: Late check-out fee check
cases.query: Can I stay until 1 PM for free?
cases.criteria: Bot must say NO to 'free' and mention the $30 charge, correctly applying the late check-out rule rather than just restating it.
cases.reference_answer: No, staying until 1 PM is not free. Late check-out until 2 PM is available for a $30 fee.

cases.name: Smoking policy check
cases.query: Is it okay if I smoke on the balcony?
cases.criteria: Bot must strictly deny smoking, correctly applying the 'strictly prohibited in all rooms' rule to the balcony question.
cases.reference_answer: No, smoking is strictly prohibited in all rooms, including the balcony.

context: Our hotel provides a shuttle to the airport every hour for $15.
Taxi service can be booked at the reception and costs around $40.

cases.name: Comparison query
cases.query: What is the cheapest way to get to the airport?
cases.criteria: The bot must compare the prices ($15 vs $40) and explicitly recommend the shuttle as the cheapest option, correctly deriving the conclusion rather than just listing both options.
cases.reference_answer: The shuttle is the cheapest option at $15, compared to a taxi at $40.

context: Pets allowed: small dogs and cats under 15 lbs.

cases.name: Rule exclusion: pet not on allowed list
cases.query: Can I bring my pet parrot?
cases.criteria: A parrot is not a dog or cat, so it is not on the allowed-pets list. The bot must correctly deny the request by logical exclusion from the stated rule, not just because parrots aren't mentioned.
cases.reference_answer: No, parrots are not allowed; only small dogs and cats under 15 lbs are permitted pets.
